body:
# TPA Fabric Mod

A simple and practical **Minecraft Fabric server-side mod** providing common player teleportation features, such as **TPA, Home, Back**, and more.

# ✨ Key Features

### 📍 Player Teleport Request (TPA)
Send a teleport request to other players.

/tpa <player>

The recipient can choose to accept or decline.

/tpaaccept
/tpadeny

---

### 🏠 Home System
Players can set multiple homes and teleport there quickly.

Set a home location
/sethome <name>

Teleport to home
/home <name>

Delete a home location
/delhome <name>

---

### 💀 Back System
Players can return to their last death location after dying.

/back

---

### ⏳ Teleport Warmup Mechanism

All teleports have a **5-second warmup**:

- **Moving** during this time will cancel the teleport
- **Taking damage** will cancel the teleport

Prevents abuse of teleportation during combat.
